title: ASME A17.1 car area, freight loading classes and small-lift limits (through makers, states and the VA)
edition: ASME A17.1 Rule 2.16.1, Table 2.16.1.1, as restated by Hollister-Whitney and VA PG 18-10
notes: A17.1 itself was not read; the table comes from makers and the VA, so findings are advisory. Rows stop at 6000 lb because the 8000 lb row differs between sources (research/16 M2). Loads are converted from pounds. The freight classes come from California Title 8 §3101, which restates A17.1 2.16.2.2. The LULA, residence and dumbwaiter limits come from makers and state codes; the residence area differs by edition (research/16 M16).

car_area.description: Maximum inside net platform area for a passenger car's rated load

freight_classes.description: A freight car's rated load is at least its inside area times 50 lb/ft² (244 kg/m²) for classes A and C, 30 lb/ft² (146 kg/m²) for class B (motor vehicles)

rows.description: general freight, by hand or hand truck
industrial truck rides with the load
truck loads and unloads, does not ride

limits.description: LULA: platform at most 18 ft² (1.67 m²), rated load at most 1400 lb (635 kg), rise at most 25 ft (7.62 m)
Private-residence elevator: inside area at most 15 ft² (1.39 m²; 18 ft² in some later editions), rise at most 50 ft (15.24 m)
Dumbwaiter: car floor at most 9 ft² (0.84 m²), inside height at most 4 ft (1219 mm), rated load at most 500 lb (227 kg)
